library.archive_hint: Creates a ZIP under Archives/ (video is stored as-is, not re-compressed), then deletes the originals.
library.archive_working_hint: You can keep using the app — this runs in the background.
library.export_confirm: Pack "%s" into a ZIP you can copy to another device?
library.export_hint: Creates a ZIP under Exports/ (video stored as-is). Originals stay in the library. On the other PC use Import ZIP.
library.export_working_hint: You can keep using the app — this runs in the background.
library.import_hint: Choose a ZIP exported from another Seerr — unpacked into your library without downloading.
library.import_no_video: No video found in the ZIP
library.import_no_dialog: No file dialog available (xdg-desktop-portal). Install xdg-desktop-portal and a backend for your desktop, or drop a .zip into the opened Imports folder and click Import ZIP again.
library.install_episodes_hint: Pick a season and the episodes you want to download. Episodes you already have are skipped.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Everything runs in one app — torrent search + libtorrent + library
settings.advanced_hint: For nerds. Frame pacing, debug HUD, and diagnostic tools. Wrong settings can make the UI feel choppy — 60 FPS + vsync is the safe default.
settings.ui_target_fps_hint: Used when the GPU driver ignores vsync (common on Linux). Uncapped can spin a CPU core.
settings.ui_vsync_hint: Syncs redraw to the display refresh. Turn off only if you know you need it.
settings.show_debug_hud_hint: Top-right overlay: FPS, frame time, worker jobs, torrent peers, vsync/cap.
settings.image_p2p_hint: Share/fetch poster images over BitTorrent DHT between Seerr clients. Disable if you only want plain HTTP downloads (or set SEERR_DISABLE_IMGSWARM=1).
settings.image_fetch_priority_hint: Which source to try first for missing posters. The other is used as fallback.
settings.image_p2p_sent_hint: How many full posters this app has uploaded to other Seerr peers (lifetime).
settings.image_p2p_sent_detail: This session: %llu sent · %llu offered · seeding %d now · %.2f MB uploaded
settings.clear_image_cache_hint: Drops in-memory poster textures and re-downloads what is on screen.
settings.library_hint: Choose which disk new movies save to. The previous folder stays as a second library — both are scanned.
settings.downloads_hint: Staging folder (prefer SSD). Torrents download here, then copy to the library disk (HDD-friendly cache).
settings.save_disk_hint: Picks Seerr/Movies and Seerr/TV on that volume. Your old folders stay visible in the library.
settings.extra_libraries_hint: Titles on these folders still appear in Library. Remove only unlinks the path — files stay on disk.
settings.download_cache_hint: After import, staging files are deleted. Older cache folders are pruned when this limit is exceeded. Put this folder on an SSD when the library is on HDD.
settings.auto_start_hint: When off, requests stay queued until you start them from Requests.
settings.auto_update_hint: When off, Seerr will not check or install updates in the background. You can still check manually. System (.deb) installs will ask for permission before applying an update.
settings.subs_hint1: Works without a key via TheSubDB (EN) and NapiProjekt (PL) using the video hash.
settings.subs_hint2: An OpenSubtitles key unlocks more languages and TV episodes (optional).
settings.subs_os_hint: Get a free API key at opensubtitles.com/consumers — a free account is enough.
update.settings_hint: Checks GitHub in the background and downloads only changed files (SHA-256). System installs ask for permission before writing.
update.idle_permission: Automatic updates enabled — will ask for permission to install
update.ready_permission: Update ready — you'll be asked for permission, then Seerr restarts…
update.not_writable: Install folder is not writable — auto-update unavailable
update.bad_platform: Update is for a different platform
